auth_details: API token via X-API-TOKEN header; X-API-SECRET and X-Requested-With often required. Token from Settings → Account Management → API Tokens. Company context via X-API-COMPANY-KEY or token binding.
free_tier_limits: Hosted Free: 1 user, limited features (no client portal branding etc.); self-host free. API rate limits not published as free-tier request quotas.
paid_plans: Pro and Enterprise hosted plans; see invoiceninja.com/pricing for current tiers.
description: Invoice Ninja provides a REST API for self-hosted and hosted invoicing: create clients and invoices, track payments and expenses, manage products and recurring billing. Authentication uses an API token (X-API-TOKEN) plus company context headers. Hosted plans start free; self-host is free under open source.
resolution_notes: Pending live verification of auth, pricing, and license disputes.
